name: 배경 객체 물리 분석
description: Validates physics consistency of background objects (shadows, reflections, perspective) across frames.
mechanism:
이 방법은 verifies physical plausibility of background objects in video for deepfake and manipulation detection following Farid (2016):

1. **Object감지&추적**: Background objects (furniture, walls, windows, vehicles) are detected and tracked 프레임 전반에 걸쳐. Their positions, orientations, and visible surfaces are monitored for physical consistency throughout the video sequence.

2. **Perspective일관성검증**: Object geometry is analyzed for correct linear perspective. Parallel edges should converge at 일관된 vanishing points across all background objects. Manipulated videos may introduce objects with 일관성 없는 perspective geometry or perspective that shifts inconsistently with camera motion.

3. **Lighting&그림자Physics**: Shadow directions, ambient occlusion, and specular highlights on background objects are verified for mutual consistency and agreement with the primary light source direction. Composited backgrounds or AI 생성 scenes may produce physically impossible shadow configurations.

4. **시간적물리적일관성**: Background objects must obey physical laws — rigid objects maintain shape, occluded objects remain 일관된 when revealed, and object motion follows Newtonian mechanics. AI 생성 backgrounds may produce objects that subtly deform, disappear/reappear inconsistently, or move in physically impossible ways.

5. **ChromaticAberration&렌즈Effects**: Real camera lenses produce 일관된 chromatic aberration and distortion across the entire field of view. Background objects should exhibit the same optical characteristics as foreground subjects. Composited or generated backgrounds may show 일관성 없는 lens effects, serving as manipulation indicators per Johnson & Farid (2007).
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적

references.title: Farid, H. (2016). Photo Forensics. MIT Press.
Johnson, M.K. & Farid, H. (2007). Exposing Digital Forgeries Through Chromatic Aberration. ACM MMSEC.
